project: Surrogate-assisted multi-objective optimisation of an RC frame for cost and embodied carbon
gravity_only_caveat: Designs are checked for gravity loading only (1.5 (DL + LL), IS 456:2000). A real building in India must also be designed for seismic (IS 1893:2016) and, where applicable, wind (IS 875-3) loading. Bhopal falls in a low-seismicity zone, but code-mandated seismic design still applies; confirm the zone from IS 1893 (Part 1):2016. Results are for design-stage trade-off exploration, not final design.
honest_novelty: NSGA-II for RC frame cost optimisation has been published since at least 2016 (e.g. Kaveh et al., J. Civil Eng. & Management, 2016), and surrogate-assisted NSGA-II for cost/carbon exists in adjacent domains (concrete mix design). This project does not claim a new algorithm. Its contribution is a carefully validated, India-contextualised application: IS-code basis, discrete IS-standard sections / bars / grades, Indian-context carbon factors with the gaps flagged, and a reported surrogate-versus-ground-truth reliability result.

findings.text: Cost rates, emission factors and the IS 456 table transcriptions are PROVISIONAL (not verified). Absolute INR / kgCO2e values are indicative only.
Gravity loading only: no seismic or wind design. See the caveat on every design page.

Deflection (L/250) never governed in the 15500 analysed designs (largest ratio 0.79); shear (tau_v / tau_c,max) never exceeded 0.62. Flexure, column interaction and steel limits are the binding constraints.
Surrogate hold-out MAE of U_flex: A 0.026, B 0.0010; near the feasibility boundary A 0.021, B 0.0009.
Feasibility agreement near the boundary: A 94.7 %, B 99.8 % (A: 23 false-feasible of 1067).
Verification (headline front A): 2 of 30 designs pass (7 %; target 90 %). 2 are truly feasible. The 90 % target was NOT met: see the failure list.
Verification Surrogate A + safety margin: 18 / 30 pass (60 %).
Verification Surrogate B + safety margin: 29 / 30 pass (97 %).

Pareto front proper: {'A': 1, 'A_margin': 3, 'B': 1, 'B_margin': 3, 'direct': 1} non-dominated points per configuration (criterion S1, at least 25, NOT met). Cost and carbon are strongly correlated over the 3598 truly feasible designs (r = 0.975) because both follow material volume; the dashboard therefore shows the near-Pareto set (first non-dominated ranks, about 100 designs).

Compute: a cold FE solve takes 36 ms; the surrogate-driven NSGA-II is 3.1x faster than direct FE for the optimisation alone and 0.93x including data generation and training. The surrogate did NOT pay off in this setting.
Entire pooled front A re-evaluated: 16 % truly feasible; hypervolume gap predicted vs true 26.5 %.

Under +/-20 % changes of steel cost, cement carbon and steel carbon, the baseline cost/carbon optima lose at most 0.7 % against the best design available under each scenario, and the worst rank correlation of cost/carbon across the baseline set is 0.801. The optimum or the ordering is NOT fully robust to these perturbations: see the scenario table.
